**Issue #4292 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4292: Patch: Radiant de-keywording
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

**Radiant de-keywording.** Each Radiant face below adds a new keyword on top of a second upgrade: a bigger number, a rewritten line or a bigger keyword. The owner reviewed every flagged card and chose which of the two upgrades each face keeps. Each face now keeps one upgrade and is still about twice its base face (R275).

How the cards were found: compare each catalog entry's base and Radiant faces. Flag a face when it gains a keyword the base face lacks **and** also changes something besides attack and health: a param, its text with the keyword line set aside, a keyword's number, or its type. 52 of the 136 faces that gain a keyword were flagged. The owner cut 31 of them (below), kept 20 as they are, and left Quad (`stinkyscapeplus-122`) to #4285, which already strips its Radiant Armor.

**One rule from the review:** a face that gains Lucky keeps Lucky, and its odds go back to the base face's.

Every id, keyword line and number below was read from `crates/cards/catalog.json` on `main` (2026-11-20). Only the **Radiant** face changes. Base faces, stats and costs stay as they are. Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10).

#### 1. Drop the keyword the Radiant face gained (23 cards)

| Card (id) | Radiant face now: stats · keywords | After (Radiant face only) |
|---|---|---|
| Core #50 K-Pop Fanatic (`core-050`) | 2/2 · Divine Shield | Loses **Divine Shield**. |
| Core #89 Corpse Eater (`core-089`) | 4/4 · Rush, Divine Shield, Brittle 3 | Loses **Divine Shield**. |
| C+ #73.1 Classic Golem (`classicplus-073-1`) | 20/20 · Rush, Trample, Divine Shield, Frenzy | **First Strike** comes back in place of Divine Shield: Rush, First Strike, Trample, Frenzy. Its non-Radiant transform stays. |
| C+ #T-AI-1 Helpful Assistant (`classicplus-t-ai-01`) | 2/6 · Taunt, Divine Shield | Loses **Divine Shield**. |
| M #45 Knowledge Breaker (`meditative-045`) | 2/6 · Divine Shield | Loses **Divine Shield**. |
| M #45.1 Knowledge Breaker Prime (`meditative-045-1`) | 12/36 · Rush, Poisonous | Loses **Poisonous**. |
| M #49.1 YileGPT Prime (`meditative-049-1`) | 16/40 · Armor 5 | Loses **Armor 5**. |
| M #93 Growing Felinor (`meditative-093`) | 2/2 · Divine Shield, Rush, Can't Defend | Loses **Divine Shield** only. Keeps Rush and the Radiant next stage. |
| M #93.1 Growing Felinor Sr (`meditative-093-1`) | 4/4 · Divine Shield, Rush, Can't Defend | Loses **Divine Shield** only. Keeps Rush and the Radiant next stage. |
| M #93.2 Growing Felinor Sr Sr (`meditative-093-2`) | 6/6 · Divine Shield, Rush, Can't Defend | Loses **Divine Shield** only. Keeps Rush and the Radiant next stage. |
| S+ #42 Force Projector (`stinkyscapeplus-042`) | — · Armor 2 | Loses **Armor 2**. |
| S+ #64 Surge Wall (`stinkyscapeplus-064`) | 0/12 · Can't attack, Taunt, Pierce, Armor 2 | Loses **Pierce** and **Armor 2**. |
| S+ #111 Mace (`stinkyscapeplus-111`) | 4/4 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Rush, Pierce | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #112 Fortress (`stinkyscapeplus-112`) | 12/6 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Pierce, Rush, Armor 4 | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #114 Reign (`stinkyscapeplus-114`) | 24/16 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Windfury, Pierce, Rush, Cleave, Armor 4 | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #117 Zenith (`stinkyscapeplus-117`) | 10/6 · Flying, Ranged, Pierce, Rush, Can't Defend | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #118 Antumbra (`stinkyscapeplus-118`) | 12/26 · Flying, Ranged, Pierce, Rush, Can't Defend | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #119 Eclipse (`stinkyscapeplus-119`) | 18/34 · Flying, Ranged, Pierce, Rush, Can't Defend, Crater, Armor 6 | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #123 Oct (`stinkyscapeplus-123`) | 8/32 · Can't attack, Can't Defend, Flying, Armor 2 | Loses **Armor 2**. |
| S+ #133.2 Macizon (`stinkyscapeplus-133-2`) | 10/6 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Rush, Pierce, Flying, Reborn, Can't Defend | Loses **Reborn**. |
| S+ #133.3 Fortnith (`stinkyscapeplus-133-3`) | 22/12 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Pierce, Rush, Armor 4, Flying, Can't Defend | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #133.4 Sceptumbra (`stinkyscapeplus-133-4`) | 28/36 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Windfury, Pierce, Rush, Armor 3, Flying, Can't Defend | Loses **Rush**. |
| S+ #133.5 Reignclipse (`stinkyscapeplus-133-5`) | 38/46 · Immutable, Immune to Spells, Ranged, Windfury, Pierce, Rush, Cleave, Armor 4, Flying, Can't Defend, Crater, Armor 6 | Loses **Rush**. |

#### 2. Keep the keyword, roll back the other upgrade (8 cards)

| Card (id) | Radiant face now: stats · keywords | After (Radiant face only) |
|---|---|---|
| Core #23 Reoccurring Dream (`core-023`) | — · Lucky 1 | `chance` 40 → **30**. Keeps Lucky 1. |
| TG #49 Legacy: Reoccurring Dream (`traininggrounds-049`) | — · Lucky 1 | `chance` 40 → **30**. Keeps Lucky 1. |
| C+ #19.1 Top Loser (`classicplus-019-1`) | 6/6 · Armor 4, Immune to Spells, Can't Defend | Armor 4 → **2**. Keeps Immune to Spells. |
| S #53 Flak v3 (`stinkyscape-053`) | 0/4 · Starship Piece, Equip, Lucky 1 | Damage back to a random **1 to 3** (`least` 2 → 1, `most` 4 → 3). Keeps Lucky 1. |
| S #57 Flak v4 (`stinkyscape-057`) | 0/6 · Starship Piece, Equip, Lucky 1 | Damage back to a random **1 to 3** (`least` 2 → 1, `most` 4 → 3). Keeps Lucky 1. |
| S #61 Flak v5 (`stinkyscape-061`) | 0/8 · Starship Piece, Equip, Lucky 1 | Damage back to a random **1 to 3** (`least` 2 → 1, `most` 4 → 3). Keeps Lucky 1 and its "Activate 3". |
| S #145 Fortify Flesh (`stinkyscape-145`) | — · Lucky 1 | Armor back to a random **3 to 5** (`most` 7 → 5). Keeps Lucky 1. |
| TG #26 Path of Exile (`traininggrounds-026`) | — · Cleave | `draw` 2 → **1**. Keeps Cleave. |

The three Flak cards lose Equip in #4285. Build on top of that and leave Starship Piece and the rest of their keyword line as #4285 leaves them.

#### Kept as they are (no change)

The owner kept these 20 Radiant faces as they are. Do not touch them: Mid Loser (`classicplus-019-3`), Support Loser (`-019-4`), Bot Loser (`-019-5`), Nuestro hogar, nuestras tumbas (`classicplus-028`), Book of Tokens (`-053`), Two Grapes (`-065`), Vine of Grapes (`-066`), Death by 1000 cuts (`meditative-005`), CN Peptides (`-036`), Money Machine (`-054`), CN Golem (`-095-1`), Mega Church (`-097-4`), Rod of Ages (`stinkyscape-016`), Job Application (`-112`), Stimmycheck (`-153`), Starfruit (`stinkyscapeplus-001`), Explosive Runes (`traininggrounds-013`), Explosive Trap (`-014`), Guerilla Felinor (`-033`), Legacy: Corpse Eater (`-056`).

#### Spec and patch bookkeeping

- Change each card's Radiant face in `catalog.json`, its script and params, its `spec/08-catalog.md` row (`spec/07-tokens.md` for a token), and its Radiant `text`, in the same pull request. Every old behavior stays foldable, as `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` says for a shipped card (the `script_v…` kept-version pattern, R767000).
- Update each card's row in `docs/radiant-audit.md`: the face now upgrades one thing, still R275's 100–150%. `crates/cards/tests/cross/radiant_standard.rs` must still pass, R276 included, since every face still differs from its base.
- Each card's script tests (CLAUDE.md rule 6) cover the new Radiant face: the dropped keyword is gone, the kept one still works, and a rolled-back number reads its new value.
- One pending fragment: `cargo jackioh patches "Radiant de-keywording" --source "#<this issue>" --notes "…"`, with its player note written by hand (`changes` lines for the dropped keywords, `balance` lines "from … to …" for the rolled-back numbers).
- A decision the spec does not already make gets a ruling note in this issue's R-block with a proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3). None is expected.
- Out of scope: Reignclipse's base face prints Armor twice (Armor 4 and Armor 3) and two "Damage also Burns" lines. Leave that alone here. If it looks like a bug, open a separate issue.

### Acceptance

- [ ] The 23 faces in table 1 lack the keyword named, and nothing else on them changes (Classic Golem: First Strike in place of Divine Shield; Growing Felinor's three stages keep Rush).
- [ ] The 8 faces in table 2 keep their keyword, and each named number on the Radiant face equals the "After" value.
- [ ] The 20 kept cards and Quad are unchanged by this pull request.
- [ ] A table in the pull request has one row per card: id, what changed, and the test that proves it (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, A task over every card).
- [ ] Every older version still folds: `cargo jackioh golden check` passes, and every shipped replay that played these cards replays unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `names --check` and `classify --base origin/main --claims` pass, and so do `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `cargo jackioh gate`.

### Blocked by, part of

Blocked by #4285 (Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes IV). It changes Flak v3–v5 and Quad, edits the same `catalog.json`, `spec/08-catalog.md` and Stinkyscape scripts, and cuts a patch fragment. Start once it has merged.
```
